scope: BiliSum real-material Phase 1: images plus transcript plus visual notes to game analysis dossier
target_questions: Can this BiliSum material support a comprehensive and accurate gameplay analysis dossier?
What are the core loop, combat resolution, deckbuilding constraints, in-run economy, and growth routes of Anode Heart: Layer Null?
Which structures can transfer into the current unique-core-card card-battle project?
thesis: Anode Heart: Layer Null uses a loop of card collection, 40-card deckbuilding, regional BO3 battles, loss diagnosis, and deck rebuilding. The BiliSum materials strongly support combat, deckbuilding, economy, and growth-route analysis, but do not support market, retention, or full narrative conclusions.

modules.title: 游戏核心定位、基础信息、商业大盘复盘
modules.claim: The material confirms a card-collection and deckbuilding RPG structure with 643 cards, six attributes, four card types, regional bosses, and a 12-region long-term goal; commercial facts remain unverified.
open_questions: Release, platform, monetization, ratings, and retention are not verified by local materials.

modules.title: 全局玩家体验与底层设计目标
modules.claim: The player experience centers on entering a boss fight with an existing deck, discovering failure causes through combat, then rebuilding into a stronger attribute route.
open_questions: Single-video sample; broader player experience needs more samples.

modules.title: 核心玩法循环
modules.claim: The core loop is collect cards, build a 40-card deck, test it in regional BO3 combat, diagnose deck failures, and rebuild around better attribute and growth routes.
open_questions: Map exploration and drop reward flow are inferred from narration, not fully shown.

modules.title: 全链路游戏架构拆解
modules.claim: The system is a linked architecture of card pool, deckbuilding, attribute energy, unit combat, app support cards, patch counters, passive skills, fragment shop, evolution, recycle/revive, and regional bosses.
open_questions: Virus card type, full rarity/drop tables, and complete region rewards are not shown.

modules.title: 内容与关卡体系
modules.claim: Content progression appears to use 12 regions and bosses; the forest region pushes the player from beginner colorless cards toward a grass growth route.
open_questions: Only forest region is shown; other 11 regions are unknown.

modules.title: 数值体系与经济资源闭环
modules.claim: The resource loop combines action count, energy costs, unit limit, draw, fragments, shop skills, evolution prerequisites, and discard-pile recycle/revive; stacked constraints create brick risk.
open_questions: Long-term currency economy and card acquisition economy are not shown.

modules.title: 叙事体系、角色 IP 与视听包装
modules.claim: The material confirms pixel visuals, English text friction, a 12-region story frame, and a likely save-the-world premise, but narrative is secondary to card-effect reading in this video.
open_questions: Story, characters, audio, and full visual identity are under-evidenced.

modules.title: 优劣复盘与可落地优化方案
modules.claim: Reusable strengths include region-driven attribute routes, counter interaction, evolution chains, recycle/revive loops, and combat feedback that points back to deckbuilding; risks include high reading load, weak beginner colorless growth, brick risk, and unclear phase UI.
open_questions: Risks are based on one video sample and need player validation.
